fusions.name: Itching Swipe
fusions.desc: A weapon swipe that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, with a 25% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Unheard Pounce
fusions.desc: A pounce on an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 26 damage, up to 1.6 times that at the full 7 tiles. It always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Feet First
fusions.desc: You hop 2 tiles, and for 3 seconds blows deal no damage to you and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Scratch Fever
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage. You have 5% more dodge chance.
